reviews.comment: She is a very nice prof and is willing to explain any concepts you may not understand. Theres many homework assignments due weekly and weekly recitation quizzes. Exams are extraordinarily difficult, however, she compensates for this by adjusting a massive curve. Her overall grading is based off cutoffs adjusted from class averages.

I think the class itself isn't bad. I learned quite a bit but the exams are just awful. So much content, yet closed-note and no calculators. I just never have enough time to get through the exams. She could provide a 4-function calculator but she doesn't. It's a harsh class because of the exams even though I feel like I understand the content.

awful. She curves but she wouldn't need to if her exams made any sense at all. Exams not following what she tells us to review, avg of 50, no calculator, NEVER enough time. Difficult for the sake of difficult, almost as if she's challenging herself to see how many people she can fail. positive comments are from freshmen who don't know any better

She is very nice, but this class is extremely difficult. Calc 1 shouldn't be this hard. She teaches it as though we have the same understandings of concepts as she does, and moves very quickly. You will have 50+ HW problems a week. The tests are impossible, I never passed one despite studying, but she curves and I got a B. Be ready to work hard.

This is a really difficult class.  Be prepared to do a lot of memorization, she will ask you to state word for word definitions and theorems on the exams.  The exams are beasts, but she does it intentional and then curves them very heavily.  Her notes go on canvas but if you aren't going to class there's really no hope. A third of the class drops.

Lectures and homework does not prepare you for the exams. I understand Calculus 1 is difficult, but I retook it with another prof and got an A easily. Makes it way harder than it needs to be, and it feels like the empathy for the self-made exams is lacking. Her grading basically pits you against your fellow students, for better or for worse.

The exams were really heavy, and most of the class thought so too. The average for those exams would be around 50%. In class, she would be surprised and claim that those exams were easy. She is nice though, but I would get lost in some lectures.

Math 171 is a hard class and you don't really know what's gonna show up on the test out of a thousand things. This is my second time taking calculus 1 however(last time being business calculus) and I will say that my level of understanding is much much deeper. Study a lot harder than you think you need to for the tests and you will do well.

Dr. Bobkova is extremely sweet and approachable. The course content is difficult, especially with no previous calculus knowledge, but the professor does her best. She also curves the exams and is extremely kind when answering questions. Overall, this is a difficult course, but Dr. Bobokva makes it passible if you put in effort.

As someone who didn't take calculus in high school, this class was nearly impossible. Some other people in the class who previously took calculus told me that she explained things as if everyone had already taken calculus. We only got our letter grades once before the end of her semester. However, her grading system saved my grade last minute.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Bobkova is a very caring and sweet prof! Beware, she moves very quickly during lectures so try to skim through the textbook ahead of class so it's easier to keep up with her. She assigns homework that isn't mandatory, but if you want to succeed I highly recommend you do it. If you go to her office hours, she is very helpful! Overall good prof

I saw previous reviews on here and wanted to clarify. Her grading system ensures that 60% of the class has an A or a B and gives a substantial curve. A B raw score in my section became and A. People only complain about her because they struggle with the content, which is fairly standard for 171.

I would not recommend Professor Bobkova if you plan to go to a professional school after A&M. Half the class have C grades, including math majors. Her accent is difficult to comprehend. Her own TA is confused. She cannot explain concepts clearly and ia ineffective a teacher.

Bobkova gets confused a lot with her own work. I took Calc AB in high school but some of the material is completely new and Bobkova doesn't really know how to explain lots of things in ways her students can understand. If you've taken Calc AB in high school, her class is manageable but if you haven't, getting an A in the class will be super hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Irina is definitely knowledgeable in Calculus. Her class started out difficult because she has an accent but I quickly became accustomed to it. Her tests are hard but she gives a good curve. There is no mandatory homework in this class. She only had weekly 3-4 question quizzes but half the time the problems were derived from the practice problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy
